linkers.note: Standard flexible fusion linker; choice is a design decision.

linkers.name: GS_short_(GGGGS)x1

linkers.name: rigid_(EAAAK)x3
linkers.source: Rigid alpha-helical linker; Chen, Zaro & Shen (2013).
linkers.note: Rigid helical linker to keep domains apart.
